relationships.subject: oxaliplatin
relationships.evidence_quote: These data illustrated OXA administration triggered NLRP3-mediated inflammatory response.

key_findings: Intrathecal 2-BP relieved oxaliplatin-induced mechanical allodynia and reduced spinal NLRP3, cleaved caspase-1, IL-1beta, COX-2 and Drp1 Ser616 phosphorylation.
In TNF-alpha-treated C6 glial cells, 2-BP restored mitochondrial membrane potential and reduced ROS.
